title: Synthesis and anti-inflammatory activity of novel steroidal chalcones with 3beta-pregnenolone ester derivatives in RAW 264.7 cells in vitro.
authors: Cai, Xiaorui; Sha, Fei; Zhao, Chuanyi; Zheng, Zhiwei; Zhao, Shulin; Zhu, Zhiwei; Zhu, Huide; Chen, Jiaoling; Chen, Yicun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究类固醇查尔酮衍生物的合成及其抗炎活性，涉及小分子与炎症蛋白的分子对接，但核心对象为小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: To identify new potential anti-inflammatory agents, we herein report the synthesis of novel steroidal chalcones with 3beta-pregnenolone esters of cinnamic acid derivatives using pregnenolone as the starting material. The structures of the newly synthesised compounds were confirmed by (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, HRMS and infrared imaging. All the derivatives were examined to determine their in vitro anti-inflammatory profiles against LPS-induced inflammation in RAW 264.7 cells; the derivates were evaluated by the quantification of the pro-inflammatory mediator nitric oxide (NO) in the cell culture supernatant based on the Griess reaction, which measures nitrite levels, followed by an in vitro cytotoxicity study. Among these novel derivatives, compound 11e [3beta-3-phenyl acrylate-pregn-5-en-17beta-yl-3' -(p-fluoro)-phenylprop-2'-en-1'-one] was identified as the most potent anti-inflammatory agent, which showed significant anti-inflammatory activity by inhibiting the LPS-induced pro-inflammatory mediator NO in a dose-dependent manner without any cytotoxicity. Moreover, compound 11e markedly inhibited the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), interleukin-6 (IL-6), tumour necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), in LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells. Further studies confirmed that compound 11e significantly suppressed the transcriptional activity of NF-kappaB in activated RAW 264.7 cells. Molecular docking study revealed the strong binding affinity of compound 11e to the active site of the pro-inflammatory proteins, which confirmed that compound 11e acted as an anti-inflammatory mediator. These results indicated that steroidal chalcones with 3beta-pregnenolone esters of cinnamic acid derivatives might be considered for further research in the design of anti-inflammatory drugs, and compound 11e might be a promising therapeutic anti-inflammatory drug candidate.
abstract_zh: 为发现新的潜在抗炎药物，我们以孕烯醇酮为起始原料，报道了含有3β-孕烯醇酮肉桂酸衍生物酯的新型甾体查尔酮的合成。新合成化合物的结构通过(1)H NMR、(13)C NMR、HRMS和红外成像进行了确认。对所有衍生物进行了体外抗炎活性评估，针对LPS诱导的RAW 264.7细胞炎症模型；通过基于Griess反应（测量亚硝酸盐水平）定量细胞培养上清液中的促炎介质一氧化氮（NO），随后进行体外细胞毒性研究。在这些新型衍生物中，化合物11e [3β-3-苯基丙烯酸酯-孕甾-5-烯-17β-基-3'-(对氟)-苯基丙-2'-烯-1'-酮] 被鉴定为最具潜力的抗炎剂，其通过剂量依赖性抑制LPS诱导的促炎介质NO表现出显著抗炎活性，且无任何细胞毒性。此外，化合物11e显著抑制了LPS诱导的RAW 264.7细胞中促炎细胞因子的表达，包括诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2）。进一步研究证实，化合物11e显著抑制了活化RAW 264.7细胞中NF-kappaB的转录活性。分子对接研究显示，化合物11e与促炎蛋白活性位点具有强结合亲和力，证实其作为抗炎介质发挥作用。这些结果表明，含有3β-孕烯醇酮肉桂酸衍生物酯的甾体查尔酮可能值得在抗炎药物设计中进一步研究，而化合物11e可能成为有前景的治疗性抗炎药物候选物。
